title: Lab - Remote file systems: NFS
description: Export a directory and mount it from another host.
scenario: Export a directory and mount it from another host. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Mount
tasks.instructions: From the client, mount it at /mnt/share.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Persist
tasks.instructions: Add an fstab entry with the _netdev option.
